450a25bfcf47.title: Medical Scribe Intern, Clinical AI Safety & Evaluation
450a25bfcf47.title_raw: Medical Scribe Intern, Clinical AI Safety & Evaluation
450a25bfcf47.description_html:
Transform healthcare with us.

At Qualified Health, we're redefining what's possible with Generative AI in healthcare. Our infrastructure provides the guardrails for safe AI governance, healthcare-specific agent creation, and real-time algorithm monitoring—working alongside leading health systems to drive real change.

This is more than just a job. It's an opportunity to build the future of AI in healthcare, solve complex challenges, and make a lasting impact on patient care. If you're ambitious, innovative, and ready to move fast, we'd love to have you on board.

Join us in shaping the future of healthcare.

Job Summary:

Qualified Health is seeking a Medical Scribe Intern to join the clinical team responsible for reviewing, evaluating, and labeling the outputs of our GenAI products. Working alongside our physicians, you will compare AI-generated clinical content against defined gold standards, and label the data that trains and evaluates our models.

The ideal candidate has worked as a medical scribe, or brings comparable clinical education or professional experience, and is fluent in medical terminology and clinical documentation. This is a paid, hourly internship. The work is structured and detail-intensive, and the quality of our product depends on it being done carefully. You will be trained and mentored directly by our physicians, who bring their clinical perspective to building products. Our physicians will review your work and give you direct feedback on it, and your input will shape how this function is built as it grows.

This role is not patient-facing and does not accrue clinical contact hours. What it offers instead is a close look at how clinical AI is evaluated for safety before it reaches patient care. It is a chance to learn how these tools are tested and improved, and to see firsthand how they are starting to change the way care is delivered.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Complete structured quality assurance, evaluation, and labeling tasks on GenAI outputs, following detailed written task instructions

  • Review AI-generated clinical content for accuracy, completeness, and adherence to defined criteria, documenting your reasoning clearly and consistently

  • Apply consistent judgment across a high volume of work without drifting from the rubric

  • Bring questions and blockers to the physician overseeing the work as they come up

  • Handle protected health information in accordance with HIPAA and our clinical safety and privacy standards

Required Qualifications:

  • 3+ months of experience as a medical scribe, or comparable medical educational or professional experience (for example: nursing, PA, or pre-med student; EMT, CNA, or medical assistant)

  • Working fluency in medical terminology and clinical documentation, and an understanding of how care is recorded in the chart

  • Exceptional attention to detail, and the ability to explain your reasoning clearly in writing

  • Reliable, consistent availability of 20–40 hours per week (full time preferred) across a 6 month commitment

  • Able to work onsite in Palo Alto 3 days/week

Desirable Skills and Experience:

  • Familiarity with EHR systems (Epic, Cerner) and clinical documentation workflows

  • Experience with chart abstraction, data labeling or annotation, quality improvement, or clinical research

  • Interest in AI/ML in healthcare and in how clinical AI is evaluated for safety and accuracy

Why Join Qualified Health?

You will be mentored by our physicians, who bring their clinical training to building products that change how care is delivered. You will sit with the clinical team, your findings will influence what ships, and there is opportunity to extend beyond the initial 6 months. Our physicians are glad to write letters of recommendation for interns they've worked closely with.

This is an opportunity to join a fast-growing company and a world-class team that is poised to change the healthcare industry. We are a passionate, mission-driven team that is building a category-defining product, and we are backed by premier investors.

Our employees are integral to achieving our goals, so we are proud to offer competitive pay, flexible working hours, hybrid work options, and an inclusive environment that fosters creativity and innovation.

Our Commitment to Diversity

Qualified Health is an equal opportunity employer. We believe that a diverse and inclusive workplace is essential to our success, and we are committed to building a team that reflects the world we live in. We encourage applications from all qualified individuals, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, national origin, marital status, disability, or veteran status.

Pay & Details:

This is a paid, hourly internship beginning in September 2026, at $40.00 per hour. The role runs for 6 months at 20–40 hours per week, with full time preferred, and may be extended based on performance and team needs.

Join our mission to revolutionize healthcare with AI. To apply, please send your resume through the application below.

451eb98c7d1a.title: Software Engineer - Intern
451eb98c7d1a.description_html:
Company Overview

Realm builds AI for the mining industry. We integrate with existing mine infrastructure — cameras, SCADA systems, drones, and data repositories — to predict equipment failures, detect unsafe behaviors, and optimize operations. Our platform deploys intelligence in various ways to improve productivity and safety — monitoring PPE compliance via computer vision, optimizing froth flotation processes, analyzing longwall shearer performance, tracking MSHA citation patterns, and more.

Our founders started their careers at Palantir before going on to build Blend Labs (publicly traded fintech, founded as CTO) and Even (acquired by Walmart). Our leadership team brings experience from Uber, Metropolis, and other high-bar organizations. We're a small, senior team that ships daily to production mines.

AI isn't just our product — it's how we build. We're an AI-first engineering team that uses the latest models and tooling throughout our development process, moving faster and at higher quality than traditional teams our size.

Our culture values high agency, deep ownership, collaboration, and autonomy across a fully remote workforce. Teams here move quickly and make meaningful contributions to a product that shapes global industrial outcomes.

What You'll Do

As an intern at Realm, you'll work alongside full-time engineers on real features that run at active mine sites - not toy projects or internal tooling.

  • Contribute to our TypeScript backend serving real-time mining operations data

  • Build and ship features end-to-end

  • Work on applied AI features using LLMs (Claude, GPT, Gemini) for intelligent analysis and automation

  • Contribute to computer vision pipelines leveraging LLMs and services like AWS Rekognition and TensorFlow

  • Deploy code to production via Kubernetes with CI/CD

  • Interact directly with users and translate real-world operational challenges into features

  • Work closely with our CEO -- former CTO and Cofounder of Blend Labs -- and a senior engineering team invested in your growth

What We're Looking For

Must-Have Qualifications

  • Currently a Junior or Senior pursuing a BS in Computer Science or a related field

  • Strong CS fundamentals - data structures, algorithms, and system design

  • Proficiency with agentic coding tools (Claude Code, Codex, or Cursor)

  • Comfort working across the stack, you don't need to be an expert in everything, but you're willing to figure things out

Nice-to-Have Qualifications

  • Prior internship or project experience in a production codebase

  • TypeScript experience

  • AI or computer vision experience

Interview Process

  1. Engineering quiz (async, ~60 min) — 8-question code reading and analysis assessment. No trick questions — we're testing how you think about real code.

  2. Live coding interviews — Algorithmic problem solving and a simulated development task.

  3. Behavioral interview with senior leadership — Culture fit, working style, and past experience.

Why Realm?

  • Work on mission-critical problems at the intersection of AI, security, and global infrastructure

  • Competitive paid internship compensation

  • Real ownership: your code ships to production mines

  • Direct mentorship from a senior engineering team with deep startup and industry experience

  • Dynamic, remote work environment with global reach

4584c83e3406.description_html:
Institutional Fabric for the Digital Asset Market

Founded in 2018, Talos provides institutional-grade trading technology for the global digital asset market, powering many of the major players in the crypto ecosystem. Our mission is clear: to advance the mass adoption of digital assets by seamlessly connecting institutions to the digital asset ecosystem. We are committed to building the most innovative and trusted platform in the world, supporting the entire trading lifecycle.

At Talos, you’ll find an environment that champions kindness and respect, values diverse perspectives, and upholds inclusivity at every turn. We believe every member of our team brings invaluable insights and abilities that drive Talos forward. In our pursuit of excellence, we foster a culture of trust, integrity, collaboration, and mutual growth.

We are a tight-knit yet globally distributed team of highly experienced engineers and business leaders, with hubs in New York, London, Singapore, and Cyprus. You’ll be part of a hybrid-friendly environment where your unique talents and insights will play a crucial role in building something extraordinary.

Software Engineer Intern, RFQ

Talos is seeking a Software Engineer Intern to join our RFQ team for the Summer 2027. This intern will work on a critical project related to our high-performance distributed trading systems, contributing to tools that support trading decision-making and performance evaluation. Success in this role will involve designing and building components that enhance our algorithmic capabilities while adding new features to existing infrastructure.

This is a 12-week internship running from June 1, 2027 to August 27, 2027

About RFQ: The RFQ platform provides a centralized, standardized quoting engine that routes requests across a curated network of liquidity providers and consolidates responses for side-by-side comparison. The system manages end-to-end OTC workflows with institutional governance, Nasdaq-integrated surveillance, and seamless settlement—enabling institutions to discover, compare, and execute on digital asset quotes with institutional controls and transparency.

Want to learn more about Talos’s engineering culture? Check out Sonic, our first open-source project which allows Talos to achieve microsecond network stack latency in Go: https://github.com/talostrading/sonic

Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with the Trading team to define project scope, requirements, and milestones

  • Prepare design documentation and actively participate in architectural discussions with team members

  • Build features in Go to enhance Talos's RFQ system, which is responsible for managing end-to-end OTC workflows with institutional governance, Nasdaq-integrated surveillance, and seamless settlement.

  • Add analytics and metrics to measure impact of your changes while incorporating feedback and iterating based on team input

  • Demonstrate project progress through regular demos

Required Qualifications

  • Class of 2028 pursuing a degree in Computer Science or related field

  • Proficiency in at least one compiled language (e.g., Go, C++, Java)

  • At least one previous internship involving working on backend systems in a production environment, preferably in a user-facing context

  • Knowledge of relational databases (e.g Postgres) is a plus

  • Past experience with trading systems is a plus

  • Detail-oriented, self driven, analytical, and enthusiastic about working on impactful projects

  • Strong communication skills, with an ability to convey technical concepts clearly

  • Ability to work autonomously as well as a part of a collaborative team environment

  • Energetic, creative, and a self-starter who can manage tasks autonomously

  • Local to NYC HQ

Benefits

You will also enjoy a comprehensive array of competitive benefits, regardless of your location, within our warm, welcoming, and ambitious company culture. Some of our benefits include:

  • A lunch credit of $25 USD towards lunches for days in-office

  • Evening socials with the entire office and fellow interns

  • Other in-office perks: Catered lunches on Tuesdays, snacks, and drinks

Also, check out other open positions listed on our website. Questions? Please feel free to contact earlycareers@talos.com.

45d6a278aa81.description_html:

Degree Level: Junior or Senior
Preferred Degree: Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Automotive Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or related engineering field
Sponsorship: Not Available


Shape the Future of Mobility at Nissan: Launch Your Career, Drive Innovation


We are currently looking for a Field Quality Investigations - Engineering Intern to join our team in Smyrna, TN. The FQI Rogue Task Force provides an exciting opportunity to support the launch of the new Smyrna-built Rogue while focusing on vehicle field quality. This fast-paced environment offers a strong sense of teamwork and collaboration as the team works to quickly understand field concerns, develop countermeasures, and improve customer satisfaction. Interns will gain valuable experience in technical investigations, data analytics, technical reporting, cross-functional collaboration, and automotive quality engineering.


A Day in the Life:

  • Assist in identifying field concerns related to automotive electrical and mechanical systems and components.
  • Investigate assigned field quality issues through vehicle testing, bench testing, and technical analysis.
  • Prepare technical reports, summarize findings, and communicate recommendations to stakeholders.
  • Analyze field quality information, including consumer surveys, warranty data, consumer affairs reports, field staff reports, and technical hotline data.
  • Track corrective actions and support the development of technical service bulletins and other quality improvement initiatives.

Who We’re Looking For:

Required:

  • Must be currently enrolled in an undergraduate or graduate degree program in Engineering or a related technical field.
  • Students entering their Junior, Senior, or Master's program at the start of the upcoming academic term.
  • Strong organizational skills with keen attention to detail.
  • Self-motivated with a willingness to learn and continuously develop technical and professional skills.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, including Excel, Access, PowerPoint, and Word.
  • Interest in automotive systems, vehicle quality, testing, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement.
  • GPA of 3.0 or above (Candidates will be required to provide an official or unofficial transcript during the application process for verification.)
  • Ability to perform work onsite at Smyrna, TN.

What You’ll Look Forward to at Nissan:

Connection and Collaboration: We offer Business Synergy Teams (ERGs) and opportunities for our employees to strengthen their relationships and meet people from similar and diverse backgrounds to foster a culture of belonging.


Professional Training and Development: Expand your knowledge and skills through Nissan’s rich innovation offerings, seminars, learning platforms and leadership trainings.


Nissan is committed to a drug-free workplace. All employment is contingent upon the successful completion of drug and background screenings in accordance with Nissan policies and in compliance with federal, state, and local laws, including the California Fair Chance Act and the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance. Nissan will consider qualified candidates with arrest or conviction records for employment in a manner consistent with these laws.


It is Nissan’s policy to provide Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) to all persons regardless of race, gender, military status, disability, or any other status protected by law. Candidates for this position must be legally authorized to work in the United States and will be required to provide proof of employment eligibility at the time of hire; Nissan uses E-Verify to validate employment eligibility.


NISSAN FOR EVERYONE


People are our most valuable assets, and Nissan seeks to maximize the power of each individual member of our team. When everyone belongs, the power of NISSAN is undeniable. 45f1289cc43f.title: Product Design Engineer Intern - Summer 2027
45f1289cc43f.description_html:
Skydio is the leading US drone company and the world leader in autonomous flight, the key technology for the future of drones and aerial mobility. The Skydio team combines deep expertise in artificial intelligence, best-in-class hardware and software product development, operational excellence, and customer obsession to empower a broader, more diverse audience of drone users, from utility inspectors to first responders, soldiers in battlefield scenarios, and beyond.

About the role:

As a member of the Product Design Team, you will work on meaningful projects that add value to Skydio and our users. You will solve complex, interesting problems and learn from a team of world-class engineers and researchers.

How you'll make an impact:

  • Conquer challenges creatively with a scrappy mindset

  • Design parts for next generation prototypes

  • Chase down the root cause of mission critical issues on existing or developing products

  • Find solutions with engineering design or manufacturing process changes

  • Validate your solutions with hands-on prototyping, testing, and data collection

  • Communicate with a cross functional team of engineers and suppliers around the globe

  • Present your work in design reviews and learn from senior members of our team

What makes you a good fit:

  • Relentless curiosity.

  • Ability to leverage rock solid fundamentals to create exceptional designs for complicated products.

  • Passion for elegant mechanical design at the highest and lowest levels of detail that will delight customers.

  • Experience with 3D CAD. Familiarity with CATIA is highly valued.

  • Obtaining FAA Part 107 certification within the first 60 days of employment is strongly encouraged for all Skydio employees and required for certain positions.

Bonus skills for the job (This experience is great to have, but we are also happy to teach you):

  • How to design for a broad array of manufacturing processes including: injection molding, metal casting, CNC machining, sheet metal forming, and composites.

  • How to complete DFM (design-for-manufacturing) with local and foreign suppliers

  • How to design and integrate circuit boards, antennas, and connectors into mechanical assemblies

Some examples of past projects include:

  • Gimbal Isolation: Design, simulate, re-design, DFM, and kick-off tooling for Skydio X10 gimbal vibration isolators

  • Scrappy Wind Tunnel: Exactly what it sounds like. Research what it takes to make a wind tunnel. Build a wind tunnel. Use the wind tunnel to learn about aerodynamic forces on a drone to inform design improvements.

  • Drone Battery Charger: Create prototypes for the battery charger for Skydio 2. Perform user studies, come up with a thermal solution, architect the product, and work on cosmetic surfacing.

Compensation: The hourly rate for this position is $41/hr for Undergrad, $53/hr for Graduate students, and $58/hr for PhD students*. Compensation will vary based on factors, including skill level, proficiencies, transferable knowledge, and experience. In addition to base salary, Skydio full-time employees are eligible to enroll in our benefit plans and take advantage of a variety of incentives and stipends.

*Compensation for certain positions may vary based on the position's location.
